quality_notes: Twenty-two official-source URLs were deduplicated against batches 134 through 136 before publication.
Installation and aviation free-allocation tables are treated as allowance entitlements and not physical emissions measurements.
Hospital and Small Emitter and Ultra-Small Emitter thresholds, targets and eligibility remain scheme-rule evidence rather than observed parcel emissions.
The DUKES 2025 and UK Energy in Brief 2025 announcements are scheduled for 30 July 2026; unreleased statistics were not treated as observed on 26 July 2026.
Environment Agency 2026 IED permit collections for M-R and S-Z establish regulatory status only and are not used as emissions quantities.
Waste voluntary MRV, domestic maritime scope, international maritime proposals, SAF treatment and CCS pipeline consultations are preserved as policy or compliance scope evidence.
UK ETS/CPS compensation records and carbon-market reports remain financial, market or administrative evidence rather than physical parcel emissions.
The 2026 greenhouse-gas methodology-change note is used as methodology and revision provenance only.

No unsupported conversion, allowance-to-emission substitution, target-to-measurement substitution, future-release observation, policy-to-outcome substitution or aggregate-to-parcel assignment was produced.
